instruction: A round crocheted octopus with a bulbous head and eight spiraling curly tentacles, worked in visible ombré teal-to-purple yarn stitches. Safety-eye buttons and an embroidered smile sit on the front, and the whole piece has the soft, slightly lumpy texture of hand-crafted amigurumi.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Amigurumi Octopus in a knitted/amigurumi style. A round crocheted octopus with a bulbous head and eight spiraling curly tentacles, worked in visible ombré teal-to-purple yarn stitches. Safety-eye buttons and an embroidered smile sit on the front, and the whole piece has the soft, slightly lumpy texture of hand-crafted amigurumi. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
